description: This is a composite figure combining nine secondary-electron FE-SEM micrographs of inclusions with fifteen matching EDS elemental maps, arranged in a six-row grid; each SEM group is labelled with its inclusion type. (a) and (b) are 10 µm-scale AlN particles showing polyhedral single and clustered morphology, with paired (b) EDS maps of Al (green) and N (yellow). (c) and (d) show octahedral MnS particles at 10 µm, with (d) maps of S (magenta) and Mn (cyan). (e) and (f) show elongated TiN inclusions at 10 µm, with (f) maps of Ti (cyan) and N (orange; the N map is weak and sparse). (g) is a 2 µm Al2O3-MnS composite annotated "MnS" above and "Al2O3" below, with EDS maps of Al, O, S, Mn and Fe; the Fe map is dark with a black void/shadow at the particle. (h) is a 2 µm TiN-MnS composite annotated "MnS" and "TiN". (i) is a 10 µm AlN-MnS composite annotated "AlN" and "MnS", with maps of Al, N, S and Mn. Together the panels demonstrate that each inclusion type, identified by its elemental chemistry, has a distinct three-dimensional morphology and that composite inclusions are tightly intergrown.

subfigures.description: SE-SEM micrograph labelled AlN, 10 µm scale bar; shows polyhedral single and clustered AlN particles on a smooth inclusion/matrix surface. Two arrows point to individual AlN particles.
SE-SEM micrograph labelled AlN with 10 µm scale bar showing several faceted AlN particles, paired with EDS maps of Al (green) and N (yellow) that co-localise on the same particles.
SE-SEM micrograph labelled MnS, 10 µm scale bar, showing a bright octahedral MnS particle embedded in a lighter matrix phase.
SE-SEM micrograph labelled MnS with 10 µm scale bar showing an isolated octahedral MnS particle, paired with EDS maps of S (magenta) and Mn (cyan) both concentrated on the particle.
SE-SEM micrograph labelled TiN, 10 µm scale bar, showing an elongated/angular TiN inclusion among other phases.
SE-SEM micrograph labelled TiN with 10 µm scale bar showing an elongated TiN inclusion, paired with EDS maps of Ti (cyan, strong blocky signal) and N (orange, weak sparse signal).

SE-SEM micrograph of a composite inclusion with 2 µm scale bar, arrow-annotated 'MnS' (upper) and 'Al2O3' (lower), accompanied by EDS maps of Al (cyan), O (green), S (yellow), Mn (orange) and Fe (dark red, showing a black void at the inclusion site).
SE-SEM micrograph of a TiN-MnS composite inclusion with 2 µm scale bar, arrow-annotated 'MnS' and 'TiN'; the elongated MnS body extends from the blocky TiN part.

SE-SEM micrograph of an AlN-MnS composite inclusion with 10 µm scale bar, arrow-annotated 'AlN' and 'MnS', paired with EDS maps of Al (green), N (yellow), S (magenta) and Mn (cyan) showing the two phases in close contact.

observations.observation: The figure is a composite of secondary-electron SEM micrographs of inclusion morphology combined with EDS elemental maps arranged in a six-row grid.
Panels (a) and (b) are labelled AlN and carry 10 µm scale bars; the AlN particles are polyhedral and occur as single and clustered particles.
Panels (c) and (d) are labelled MnS with 10 µm scale bars and show octahedral MnS particles, confirmed by co-located S (magenta) and Mn (cyan) EDS maps in (d).
Panels (e) and (f) are labelled TiN with 10 µm scale bars and show elongated TiN inclusions, confirmed by Ti (cyan) and N (orange) EDS maps in (f).
Panel (g) is a 2 µm-scale composite inclusion annotated 'MnS' (upper part) and 'Al2O3' (lower part), with EDS maps of Al, O, S, Mn and Fe; the Fe map is dark with a black void at the inclusion.
Panel (h) is a 2 µm-scale TiN-MnS composite inclusion annotated with arrows 'MnS' and 'TiN'.
Panel (i) is a 10 µm-scale AlN-MnS composite inclusion annotated 'AlN' and 'MnS', with EDS maps of Al, N, S and Mn.
The caption states the figure shows the morphology and type of inclusions in the 3 # sample, grouped as a,b) AlN; c,d) MnS; e,f) TiN; and g–i) composite inclusions.
The caption states the MnS inclusions (c,d) are octahedral with a size of ≈10 μm.
The citing text states the TiN inclusions (e,f) exhibit elongated shapes with lengths higher than 30 μm; no such length is printed on the panels themselves.
The citing text states that in (g) the Al2O3 inclusion lies at the bottom and the MnS inclusion lies above it.
The citing text states the TiN-MnS composite in (h) has a 'cigarette bag' shape.
The citing text states that in (i) the MnS and AlN inclusions are very tightly bound, not in a physical manner.
The abstract lists the inclusion types of the Fe-15Mn-Al-C steel as Al2O3, AlN, MnS, TiN, Al2O3-MnS, AlN-MnS, TiN-MnS.

panel (g) EDS maps: Al and O maps are low intensity and only faintly outline the Al2O3 region
